/root/ppt_cube_blind_review; retained Sol/max; no descendants.
Date: 2026-10-09. New folder; every earlier frozen byte remains immutable.

VERDICT
The full apex preimage meets EVERY pointwise hypothesis of the supplied
abstract bounded-frequency rectifiability theorem. There is no exceptional
center set and no remaining application gate. Conditional on that newly
supplied internal theorem, the apex preimage is sigma-finite for H^{m-1}
and countably (m-1)-rectifiable. This conclusion is obtained directly from
the actual tuple and bounded frequencies, not from the previous dimension
bound. The new abstract proof bodies were not requested or read. External
and formal certification, and novelty, remain UNKNOWN.

1. Exact application theorem and supplied premise

Let Omega be connected and open in R^m, m>=1. Let X=C(Y) be a complete
CAT(0) metric cone with vertex o and its standard cone metric/homotheties.
Let u be a supplied local KS W^{1,2}_loc energy minimizer and use its
canonical locally Lipschitz representative. Assume u is not identically o.
Then, conditional on premise R below,
 Z=u^{-1}(o) is sigma-finite for H^{m-1} and countably(m-1)-rectifiable.
No properness, finite target dimension or separate bounded-image hypothesis
is imposed. Finite local energy and L^2 distance are part of KS W^{1,2}.
For disconnected Omega, include only components on which canonical u is
not identically o. The statement includes surface cones of angle>=2pi.

Supplied premise R, admitted exactly as an internal theorem by root:
For a single locally finite measure tuple on an open Euclidean domain,
 T=[nu f^t;f beta]>=0, grad nu=2f, div f=d=tr beta,
 div beta=grad mu, 2mu<=d, |mu|<=C d,
the full locus G_N of centers with positive kernel height and

center. This uses the common normalized polynomial-kernel P=A/H convention

new proof body, or infer it from the old Hausdorff-dimension statement.

no additional upper-frequency or almost-every-center assumption to acquire.

formal validation or a novelty claim. No new ppt cone-rectifiability body

Let Omega be connected and open in R^m, m>=1. Let X be ANY complete CAT(0)
metric cone with apex o. Let u be a supplied locally energy-minimizing KS
map with its CANONICAL locally Lipschitz representative, and assume u is
not identically o. Constant nonapex maps are allowed and have empty apex
set. Standard finite local KS energy and the exact trace normalization
are part of the supplied premises; globally finite energy is unnecessary.

Write a(y)=d_X(u(y),o), and consume the supplied actual measures

  d=tr pi dy, mu=d/2,
  [nu f^t;f beta]>=0,
  grad nu=2f, div f=d, div beta=grad mu.                       (1.1)

graph representation is imposed. The through-apex chain rule and domain
